messages:
maya: quick design sync on API Keys list. two problems: long scope lists break row height, and reveal/copy flow isn't discoverable. sketch: https://figma.com/file/keys-ux
tonY: prefer single-line rows with a compact scope summary and a 'show scopes' popup. keeps scanning easy.
sam: popup must be keyboard accessible. make chips non-interactive and provide one disclosure button per row.
nora: a11y note: the disclosure should use aria-expanded and the popup should trap focus. also add aria-live updates for reveal actions.
maya: copy tweak for create modal: replace "shown once" with "This key will be revealed once. Save it now; you won't be able to view it again." shorter and explicit.
tonY: for ephemeral keys show an expiry pill "expires in 1h" plus a small progress indicator. toast alone isn't enough.
sam: mobile: collapse actions into a kebab, but keep 'copy' as a visible ghost button to reduce taps.
nora: revoke modal should have optional reason dropdown (for audit) and a short warning paragraph with aria-describedby.
infra-bot: reminder: feature-flag keys_ui_v3 enabled on staging 2026-04-07. include accessibility checklist before deploy.
maya: will update figma with two variants (summary vs chips), add aria examples and acceptance criteria. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
